platform_await.description: A platform tool that blocks on, or detaches, a shell call or a subagent in place of `pan watch`. Every hook denies it.

pending_probes.copilot-cli: PR-25 decides whether `read_bash` with a delay is a platform await.

subagent_launch.description: The platform tool that launches a subagent. A call that cannot run in the background is denied, because DELEGATE-001 forbids a wait on the platform subagent.

pending_probes.copilot-cli: PR-22 decides whether the `task` tool accepts a background `mode`.

shell.description: The platform shell tool that `bin/pan-hook-shell-monitor` guards.
